note: GAM-013 Ranked — weekly ordering lists. STARTER SET = engine-demo neutral verifiable orderings (five items, distinct values, factual). The correct order is DERIVED from the values (direction 'desc' = most first, 'asc' = least first) — single source of truth. The DATA-NATIVE rankings (from Claridas article datasets, with the reveal bar chart drawn from the same data, source + article link) are EDITORIAL/DATA (Onett) — same plumbing as GAM-011. These starters make the engine playable day one. Each list: question, direction, items[{label,value,unit}], context, source, retrieved, optional articleUrl.

lists.question: Order these countries by population, most to least.
lists.context: India overtook China as the most populous country around 2023.

lists.question: Order these planets by diameter, largest to smallest.
lists.context: The two gas giants dwarf the ice giants, which dwarf Earth.

lists.question: Order these oceans by area, largest to smallest.
lists.context: The Pacific alone is larger than all of Earth's land area combined.

lists.question: Order these countries by land area, largest to smallest.
lists.context: Russia is nearly twice the size of the next-largest country.

lists.question: Order these countries by number of official time zones, most to least.
lists.context: China spans five geographic zones but officially uses one.
